scripts.dev:extension:chrome: pnpm build:extension chrome && web-ext run --source-dir apps/extension/dist/chrome --target chromium --no-config-discovery
scripts.dev:extension:firefox: pnpm build:extension firefox && web-ext run --source-dir apps/extension/dist/firefox --target firefox-desktop --devtools --no-config-discovery
scripts.dev:extension:safari: pnpm build:extension safari && safari_project_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/formfully-safari.XXXXXX) && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter apps/extension/dist/safari --project-location "$safari_project_dir" --app-name "FormFully" --bundle-identifier io.github.devm7mdali.formfully --swift --macos-only --copy-resources --no-open --no-prompt && open "$safari_project_dir/FormFully/FormFully.xcodeproj"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @formfully/extension typecheck && pnpm --filter @formfully/landing-page typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.test: pnpm build:extension && pnpm --filter @formfully/extension test && node --import tsx --test tooling/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build:landing
scripts.check: pnpm verify && pnpm package:extension && pnpm lint:firefox
